_comment: Reference for the SHIPPED production supervisor-config.json (written by macos/scripts/stage-app-bundle.sh). Every bundle path is Contents/ — relative (resolved against the installed app bundle derived from the supervisor's own executable — install-location independent); app_support_dir/log_dir are ABSENT (the supervisor applies the per-user ~/Library defaults at load). The desktop webview origin is tauri://localhost (Tauri 2 macOS custom scheme). CI harnesses may pass an explicit --config with absolute paths — both forms are supported by config.rs.
